_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); electric utility signals on FPL Group's own lines

pit_profile.why: FPL Group, Inc.: 'FPL is a rate-regulated utility engaged primarily in the generation, transmission, distribution and sale of electric energy.' and 'FPL Energy is FPL Group's competitive energy subsidiary which produces the majority of its electricity from clean and renewable fuels.'; among its risk factors, 'FPL Group and FPL are subject to complex laws and regulations and to changes in laws and regulations as well as changing governmental policies and regulatory actions', 'Weather affects FPL Group's and FPL's results of operations.' and environmental rules 'relating to air quality, water quality, climate change, waste management, marine and wildlife mortality, natural resources and health and safety' (its own FY2007 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an electric utility on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on climate change stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: FPL Group, Inc.: 'FPL is a rate-regulated utility engaged primarily in the generation, transmission, distribution and sale of electric energy.' and 'FPL Energy is FPL Group's competitive energy subsidiary which produces the majority of its electricity from clean and renewable fuels.'; among its risk factors, 'FPL Group and FPL are subject to complex laws and regulations and to changes in laws and regulations as well as changing governmental policies and regulatory actions', 'Weather affects FPL Group's and FPL's results of operations.' and environmental rules 'relating to air quality, water quality, climate change, waste management, marine and wildlife mortality, natural resources and health and safety' (its own FY2007 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an electric utility on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on climate change stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +88% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.27; conservative 2yr -21%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -12.6%/yr (worst year FY98-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.1%/yr (Q1 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.1%/yr (FY98-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +18.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NEE (retrospective, 2008-05-30) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (57.0% downside to Bear $29 / +-2.3% upside to Bull $66) | Adj composite 2.50 vs market 3.77: gap -1.27 [OVERVALUED] | +88% above the EPP floor $36 (11x FY08E $3.27) | Conservative 2-yr case: -21.0% total (-10.5%/yr) | At 20.6x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $89 sits above the BULL case; FPL energy sales -0.6% in Q1 2008, forward revenues +11.7% (no Q2 2008 revenue guide, Q1 2008 revenue as reported); no disruption theme is live for an electric utility on this date.
